title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Elm is a startup building media apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Northhaven office.

Our stack: kotlin, python, go. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and own the release process.

Modern devices for testing. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
